cases.text:
CSE 300 (Social, Ethical and Professional Issues in Computing, Fall 2026) course details as of Sep 30, 2026:

- D2L Org Unit ID: 2676540. Kritik-based assignments on D2L only show a link to https://us.kritik.io with no inline prompt/rubric text — full assignment details must be fetched by logging into Kritik directly.
- Kritik (us.kritik.io) requires its own separate login credentials for desaia11@msu.edu, distinct from MSU SSO/Okta/D2L credentials. These were added to Chaavi by Ankur around Sep 30, 2026.
- Kritik Essay 2 stages: Milestone One (Create) due Sep 30, 2026 11:59pm EDT; Milestone Two (Evaluate) Oct 1 2:00am – Oct 9, 2026 11:59pm EDT; Milestone Three (Feedback) Oct 10 2:00am – Oct 13, 2026 11:59pm EDT; Grading finalized Oct 13, 2026 11:59pm EDT.
- Essay 2 prompt topic: ethical implications of a healthcare company mandating generative AI for chart notes, patient-visit voice transcription (used for billing codes), and diagnosis assistance, in pursuit of a 20% patient volume increase. Required analysis: Utilitarianism and Deontology, word count 750–1,250 words (under 750 = auto 0), no student name allowed in submission, generative AI tools (ChatGPT, Grammarly, citation generators) explicitly BANNED by course policy for writing/outlining/rephrasing — a very important recurring compliance consideration for every essay in this course.
- 4 D2L quizzes due Friday, Oct 2, 2026 11:59pm EDT: "Ethical Considerations Creating Products and Services," "Ethical Considerations for Data," "Tools to Use in Ethical Decision-Making," "Source Citations."
- Gradebook snapshot as of Sep 29, 2026: Assignment Quizzes 11.44/35 (32.69%), Discussion Sessions 3.75/15 (Session 1 complete at 100%, Sessions 2-4 pending), Essays 0/35, Exams 0/15.
- Standing org-wide policy (effective ~Sep 30, 2026): no agent may submit or finalize any coursework (quizzes, essays, discussion posts, peer evaluations) on any platform for any of Ankur's classes under any circumstances — all drafted/completed work must be delivered to Ankur for his personal review and manual submission.

cases.text:
CSE 335 (Object-Oriented Software Development, MSU Fall 2026, Ankur's course) — Step 4 "Refactoring, Files, Time, and Animation" was completed and committed locally (not submitted) on Oct 1, 2026 wake. Implementation lives in git repo /var/lib/dadi/code/cse-335, worktree /var/lib/dadi/code/cse-335.worktrees/step-4, branch feat/step-4, commit 2d68c5c. It still needs Ankur's manual review and submission via CLion (CSE335 > Connect > Export > Submit Solution) or web upload at https://cse335.egr.msu.edu/step4/submission before the Oct 1, 11:55 PM deadline.

CSE 335 course facts: Grading = 5% participation, 20% design, 35% step assignments, 40% projects; must score ≥50% in Design, ≥50% in Step, and ≥50% in Project 2 to pass. Drop deadline Monday Oct 19, 2026. Strict no-late-work policy; all submissions are manual (CLion plugin or web upload), never auto-submitted by any agent — code is always presented to Ankur for review first. Step assignments do not use git remotes (gitlab.msu.edu is reserved for team Projects 1 & 2 only); each step builds forward from the previous step's local project folder. Course uses wxWidgets (with its built-in wxXmlDocument/wxXmlNode for XML, not a third-party XML library) and Google Test, built via CMake, documented via Doxygen. Upcoming CSE 335 deadlines as of Oct 2026: Design 4 Peer Reviews due Fri Oct 2 11:55PM; Design 5 (Advanced UML Class Diagrams) due Mon Oct 5 11:55PM; Projects 1 & 2 not yet posted.

nodes.title: Networking playbook for Ankur Desai's LinkedIn alumni outreach strategy, built by networking-specialist (2026-10-06)
nodes.body: Based on web research. Recommended cadence: 35-45 invites/week spread Wed-Sun (8-10/day Wed-Fri, 4-6/day weekend), Mon/Tue kept to 0-5 async invites and no calls per Ankur's standing study-day preference. Withdraw pending invites older than 21 days.
